test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) @ 3 5 1 7 % @ 2 © 1 © © 4 4 9 & © 1 © £ 5 5 (Right)

How many such numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a symbol?
solution:
Given :- (Left) @ 3 5 1 7 % @ 2 © 1 © © 4 4 9 & © 1 © £ 5 5 (Right)

Numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a symbol

Number - Number - Symbol

(Left) @ 3 5 __**1 7 %**__ @ 2 © 1 © © 4 __**4 9 & **__© 1 © £ 5 5 (Right)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
